subject: Executive approval request: Lumen Health restrictive-access & MFN asks
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Lumen Health request: exclusivity + MFN + deep discount (attachments)

Team — quick summary from Lumen procurement (see attached redline): they want the following as part of a 24-month commitment: a 35% list discount on compute/usage for year 1, an MFN clause (broadly scoped across our hosted pricing) for the first 12 months, and a market exclusivity carveout across three named hospital systems in the NE region for the contract term.

Procurement flagged this as "strategic" and asked for an executive sign-off to move forward. Key asks: 
- 35% first-year discount (then reverts to list with standard SOW pricing)
- MFN (applies to any financial terms for comparable hosted API tiers) for 12 months
- Exclusive access to preferred integrations in 3 hospital systems (no competing supplier in these accounts for 18 months)

They returned a redline and SOC2 summary — attaching both (Lumen_Redline_v3.pdf, SOC2-summary-2028-06.pdf).

Questions: do we approve escalation to execs as-is, or propose commercial mitigations (sunset, revenue cap, limited exclusivity)? I can draft an exec one-pager if you want to escalate.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumen Health request: exclusivity + MFN + deep discount (attachments)

+1 on escalation. This package is high-risk. My immediate concerns: 
- Broad MFN => open-ended repricing exposure across our hosted tiers. Hard to operate.
- Geographic/customer exclusivity for 18 months is basically a market lock for those accounts and will create precedent.
- 35% off list for year 1 without a strong minimum commitment leaves revenue at risk if consumption misses projections.

If we escalate, propose we include: a firm revenue floor (min commitment), sunset on MFN to 6 months and scoped to the specific SKU/feature set, and exclusivity limited to named products/features + a maximum ARR cap for the exclusivity period. Also suggest a termination-for-convenience clawback if they miss adoption targets.

I can run numbers if you send expected consumption. Recommend legal be looped now.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 11:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumen Health request: exclusivity + MFN + deep discount (attachments)

Aisha / Ben — I reviewed the redline. Redlines of note: they added a broad "no third-party supplier" clause for the named hospital systems and an MFN tied to any "substantially similar" pricing for 12 months.

Proposed commercial mitigations we should put in the exec ask: 
- Exclusivity: convert to "preferred supplier" language, limited to a specific engagement type (e.g., inpatient discharge summarization workflow) and capped at $500k ARR equivalent for the exclusivity period; 9–12 month term.
- MFN: narrow to a defined product SKU list and cap to 6 months. Include a carve-out for non-hosted/private deployments.
- Discount: agree to 25% for year 1 instead of 35% but with a $150k minimum commitment; include a usage ramp milestone and a clawback if they underperform by >25%.
- Add a competitive-safeguard: right to offer a right-to-match instead of full MFN for future competitive offers.

If you want, I will synthesize into a single-page exec memo for Rishi to sign. Legal should confirm the contract language (esp. exclusivity scope).

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Exec ask: Lumen Health — request for sign-off on mitigation package

Rishi — attaching the redline and a short summary of the ask. Procurement is pressing for a decision this week. Below is the recommended mitigation package that Deal Desk and Legal propose for exec sign-off: 

1) Pricing: approve a 25% list discount for year 1 (not 35%) contingent on a $150k minimum commitment payable upfront (credit against usage).
2) MFN: limit MFN to the named hosted product SKUs (generation API and enterprise embeddings) and reduce duration to 6 months; carve out private deployments and channel marketplace agreements.
3) Exclusivity/competitive restriction: replace "no third-party supplier" with "preferred supplier" language scoped to the inpatient summarization workflow only; cap the exclusivity value to $500k ARR equivalent; sunset after 9 months.
4) Clawbacks & milestones: include quarterly adoption milestones and a proportional discount clawback if they miss ≥25% of agreed consumption targets.
5) Governance: Legal to finalize language; CS to own adoption milestones and reporting.

Attachments: Lumen_Redline_v3.pdf, SOC2-summary-2028-06.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5029142 

Requested decision: Approve the mitigation package so we can issue a counter-offer to procurement. If you reject, please indicate whether you prefer: (A) reject exclusivity entirely and offer standard commercial terms, or (B) escalate to CEO for exception.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec ask: Lumen Health — request for sign-off on mitigation package

Approved with conditions: I approve the mitigation package as outlined (25% discount + $150k min, MFN scoped to SKU + 6 months, limited preferred-supplier exclusivity capped at $500k ARR, 9-month sunset) provided Legal finalizes language and we implement the clawback + adoption milestones.

Additionally: require Deal Desk to add an explicit non-renewal clause for exclusivity (so it does not auto-extend) and CS to deliver first adoption report within 60 days of go-live. If Legal flags any material change to scope, escalate to me immediately.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
